title: Smoky Chicken Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional tacos, featuring smoky chicken and earthy flavors.

ingredients.name: shredded cheese (optional)
ingredients.notes: such as Monterey Jack or Cheddar

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cumin, paprika, coriander, and lime juice.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes.
Shred the chicken with two forks and stir in chipotle peppers.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chicken onto a tortilla and topping with cheese, radishes, and cilantro.
